title: CmdPal: Icons (3/n) - Harden icon caches and coalesce redundant refreshes
summary: The current upstream head is reviewable and builds cleanly, but it is missing two correctness fixes confirmed by the converged fork review: ETW-only listeners do not start request diagnostics, and an asynchronous completion can apply after the source-request handler has changed. The exact upstream head, exact fork head, and literal two-suggestion candidate were all validated; the drafted REQUEST_CHANGES review is pinned to the unchanged live head and awaits explicit maintainer approval.

test_instructions: Exercise CmdPal icon loading through virtualized lists and rebind an IconBox from one source handler to another while an asynchronous request is in flight.
Enable the icon diagnostics ETW provider without starting a text report, exercise icon requests, and verify request and attribution events are emitted.
Repeat a theme or scale refresh while the source handler changes and verify an obsolete completion does not replace the current icon.
